title: Sum of Perfect Square Ancestors
description:
You are given an integer n and an undirected tree rooted at node 0 with n nodes numbered from 0 to n - 1 . This is represented by a 2D array edges of length n - 1 , where edges[i] = [u i , v i ] indicates an undirected edge between nodes u i and v i . 
 
 You are also given an integer array nums , where nums[i] is the positive integer assigned to node i . 
 
 Define a value t i as the number of ancestors of node i such that the product nums[i] * nums[ancestor] is a perfect square . 
 
 Return the sum of all t i values for all nodes i in range [1, n - 1] . 
 
 Note : 

 In a rooted tree, the ancestors of node i are all nodes on the path from node i to the root node 0, excluding i itself. 

 Example 1: 

 Input: n = 3, edges = [[0,1],[1,2]], nums = [2,8,2] 
 
 Output: 3 
 
 Explanation:
